question: For each namespace, compute total requested and limit memory (MiB) across all pod containers.

candidates.cypher:
MATCH (p:Pod)-[:BelongsTo]->(ns:Namespace)
UNWIND p['spec']['containers'] AS container
WITH ns, container['resources']['requests'] AS reqs, container['resources']['limits'] AS lims
WITH ns,
  CASE
    WHEN reqs['memory'] IS NULL THEN 0.0
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Ti' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'Ti', '')) * 1024 * 1024
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Gi' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'Gi', '')) * 1024
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Mi' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'Mi', ''))
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Ki' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'Ki', '')) / 1024
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'T' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'T', '')) * 1000000000000 / 1048576
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'G' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'G', '')) * 1000000000 / 1048576
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'M' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'M', '')) * 1000000 / 1048576
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'k' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'k', '')) * 1000 / 1048576
    ELSE toFloat(reqs['memory']) / 1048576
  END AS req_memory_mib,
  CASE
    WHEN lims['memory'] IS NULL THEN 0.0
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Ti' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'Ti', '')) * 1024 * 1024
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Gi' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'Gi', '')) * 1024
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Mi' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'Mi', ''))
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Ki' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'Ki', '')) / 1024
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'T' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'T', '')) * 1000000000000 / 1048576
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'G' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'G', '')) * 1000000000 / 1048576
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'M' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'M', '')) * 1000000 / 1048576
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'k' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'k', '')) * 1000 / 1048576
    ELSE toFloat(lims['memory']) / 1048576
  END AS lim_memory_mib
RETURN ns['metadata']['name'] AS namespace,
       sum(req_memory_mib) AS total_requested_memory_mib,
       sum(lim_memory_mib) AS total_limit_memory_mib
ORDER BY namespace

    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'G' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'G', '')) * 1000000000 / 1048576
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'M' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'M', '')) * 1000000 / 1048576
    WHEN reqs['memory'] ENDS WITH 'k' THEN toFloat(replace(reqs['memory'], 'k', '')) * 1000 / 1048576
    ELSE toFloat(reqs['memory']) / 1048576
  END AS req_memory_mib,
  CASE
    WHEN lims['memory'] IS NULL THEN 0.0
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Ti' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'Ti', '')) * 1024 * 1024
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Gi' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'Gi', '')) * 1024
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Mi' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'Mi', ''))
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'Ki' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'Ki', '')) / 1024
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'T' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'T', '')) * 1000000000000 / 1048576
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'G' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'G', '')) * 1000000000 / 1048576
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'M' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'M', '')) * 1000000 / 1048576
    WHEN lims['memory'] ENDS WITH 'k' THEN toFloat(replace(lims['memory'], 'k', '')) * 1000 / 1048576
    ELSE toFloat(lims['memory']) / 1048576
  END AS lim_memory_mib
RETURN ns['metadata']['name'] AS namespace,
       sum(req_memory_mib) AS total_requested_memory_mib,
       sum(lim_memory_mib) AS total_limit_memory_mib
ORDER BY namespace
